verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking API platform (payments, account data, webhooks), not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only a server-side MCP connection to its docs, which agents such as Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the opposite role and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
